points.description: States that the compiler replaces/copies the inline function's code (body) at each place where the function is called (expands it in place of the call).
points.partial_credit: Half or more if it says the code is expanded/inserted at call sites but vaguely, or only says it avoids a function call without stating the copy/substitution.

points.description: Makes clear this happens for every call, i.e. a copy at each call site (every place the function is called).
points.partial_credit: Half if it implies multiple places only loosely, e.g. 'in the calling code'.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the compiler copies/expands the function body at every place the function is called, in any wording (e.g. 'substitutes the code at the call'). Part marks for vague statements such as 'it is expanded inline' or 'no function call is made' without the copying idea. No marks for answers that only describe a normal function call, or talk about speed or the keyword without the substitution idea.
